answer: Each epoch the network issues a per‑identity challenge built from a procedurally generated timber‑pattern puzzle whose solution must be proven against a dynamic reef of past proofs; the puzzle’s parameters are seeded from a relic hash of the previous epoch, guaranteeing freshness. An agent submits its response and a zero‑knowledge attest‑ation that the compute was performed locally, which the consensus layer verifies in O(1) time.
